title: test: crop diagnostic cases with an outlier split

commit.merge_subject: merge: test: crop diagnostic cases with an outlier split

description: Owner request: find why the crop parity misses its documented 2 LSB bound (GradeParitySweep header). Eight single-variable cases run after the 21 standard ones and log as crop-diag: a whole-pixel rect at 0 deg, the same rect shifted half a pixel, the same rect at 0.05/0.1/0.25/0.5 deg, and the whole frame at 0.5/7 deg; each line carries the output dims and, via a pure outlierSplit helper, how many pixels differ by more than 2 LSB and how many of those sit within 2 px of the border. Diagnostics only, no threshold or behaviour change. JVM tests pin the case grid and the split.
